record.specifics:
The Remind change feed emits twelve event kinds: remembered, superseded, conflict_opened, conflict_resolved, conflict_dismissed, concept_created, updated, labeled, unlabeled, deleted, restored, and processed. Read them via store.get_events, the events snapshot scope, the events MCP tool, or the remind events CLI command.
Remind 0.13.0 was released on 2026-08-08 as a single commit, 3f29ca8, titled 'Remind core changes: drop topics, add substrate primitives'.
